about_the_game:
⭐ ASCEND THROUGH A DAWNLESS WORLD

Celestial Lumina is a hand-crafted 2D Pixel Art Metroidvania where you climb from the roots of the earth to the ruins of the heavens, forging awakened abilities of living light to battle back the Darkness consuming the world.

Every ascent brings new movement, new combat tools, and new secrets — and every ability evolves into something far more powerful than when you first found it.

The world has no sunrise.
You might be the only one who can bring it back.

⚔️ AWAKEN YOUR LIGHT — Abilities With True Evolution

Your abilities don’t just get stronger — they transform, opening new combat routes, traversal tech, and creative playstyles:

Start with a simple dodge. Awaken it into a lightning form that lets you pierce straight through enemies and barriers — a literal bolt of player-controlled light.

Leave behind a burst of life that sprouts a temporary leaf platform. Movement becomes improvisation; improvisation becomes mastery.

Create instant structures for cover, routes, puzzles, or setups — combat becomes a sandbox.

✦ Starlit Arsenal

Charge your Starlit projectiles into explosive starfire, lay strategic mines, or use them to heal. Starlight is scarce — expand your supply through exploration, and choose carefully how to wield every spark of power.

✦ Take Inventory

3 Inventory Slots. Endless possibilities. Mix and match your acquired items to enhance your exploration, combat, and playstyle!

✦ Elemental Blades

Discover and swap between sword types, each reshaping your combat rhythm — fast, heavy, elemental, arc-based, or pure voltage.

Your kit doesn’t just grow — it mutates into creativity.

🌍 ASCEND A LAYERED WORLD OF LIGHT & DARKNESS

Explore 10+ interconnected regions spanning earth, sky, forest canopies, and the shattered heights of heaven. Each area introduces a new tone, mechanic, or twist on your abilities.

  • Ancient Sky Cities & Light-Forged Ruins — Discover how the Star reshaped life for those who lived near it.

  • Moonlit Grounds — Plant celestial seeds to grow elemental buffs, mobility tools, or world-changing boons.

  • Mountain Caves — Navigate hidden traversal arteries that slingshot you through the world.

  • Forests, Hanging Gardens, Starlit Peaks — Movement-focused biomes built around vertical exploration.

  • Dark Castles, Void Realms, and a Heaven Drained Hollow — Where the Darkness rewrites reality itself.

Each region pushes you to experiment with your awakened abilities in new, surprising ways.

🌓 COMBAT WHERE LIGHT IS YOUR SHARPEST WEAPON

Fast-paced, soulslike-inspired duels where:

  • mobility is a resource

  • timing matters

  • light-based abilities create explosive combos

  • enemies force adaptation, not memorization

Every fight is a test. Every upgrade is a revelation.
Every victory lights up the world a little more.

🎮 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT

  • Precision movement with full key/button rebinding

  • Evolving abilities that transform how you play

  • Over 10 unique biomes, each with new mechanics

  • Creative combat powered by elemental swords & starfire

  • Hand-crafted world design with meaningful shortcuts

  • Atmospheric storytelling revealed through exploration

  • Secrets everywhere — platforming, lore, puzzles, power routes

⭐ RISE. AWAKEN. RECLAIM THE STAR.

Climb from Fernlight Grove to the broken edge of Heaven itself.
Unmask the entity puppeteering the Darkness.
Bring back the light no one remembers — but everyone needs.

Wishlist Celestial Lumina and join the ascent.

  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: HD Graphics 5500
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek High Definition Audio
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows 11 Pro
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Creative Sound Blaster Audigy Fx

short_description: Ascend from the depths as Evan, heir of a fallen underworld, to uncover the truth behind a world stripped of dawn. Celestial Lumina is a 2D Pixel-Art Metroidvania where Light clashes with the Darkness that stole the sky.
